description: This file defines various constants, types, and utility functions related to project status and type representations in a repository difference analysis tool.

methods.name: makeDisplayToStatus
methods.description: Creates and returns a map from display status strings to their corresponding integer enums.

methods.name: GetStatusEnum
methods.description: Retrieves the enum integer value corresponding to a given display status string, initializing the map if necessary.

methods.name: invertMap
methods.description: Creates an inverted map from the given map of int-to-string to string-to-int.

methods.name: NullUUID
methods.description: Generates and returns an empty (all-zero) UUID.
